accountDetails.title: Fausia lau teugatupe
accountDetails.heading: Fausia lau teugatupe
accountDetails.intro: E mana'omia lea. Fa'aauau e fausia lau teugatupe i le {{ server_name }}. E le mafai ona e suia lea mulimuli ane.
accountDetails.checking: Siaki pe avanoa le igoa fa'aoga …
accountDetails.errorRequired: E mana'omia lea. Fa'amolemole tu'u mai se igoa fa'aoga
accountDetails.errorTooLong: Umi tele, fa'amolemole filifili se mea e sili atu ona pu'upu'u
accountDetails.errorInvalidCharacters: Igoa fa'aoga le aoga, fa'amolemole fa'aaoga na'o {{ allowed_characters }}
accountDetails.errorNotAvailable: E le avanoa le {{ username }}, fa'amolemole filifili se isi.
redirectConfirm.title: Fa'aauau i lau teugatupe
redirectConfirm.heading: Fa'aauau i lau teugatupe
redirectConfirm.trust: O le fa'aauauina o le a tu'uina atu ai le avanoa i le {{ display_url }} i lau teugatupe.
ssoError.title: Ua le manuia le fa'amaoniaina
ssoError.unauthorised: E le fa'atagaina oe e saini i totonu i'i.
ssoError.heading: Sa i ai se mea sese
ssoError.emailLinkHint: Afai o lo'o e va'ai i lenei itulau pe a uma ona kiliki se so'oga na lafo atu ia te oe e ala i imeli, ia mautinoa e na'o le tasi lava le taimi e te kiliki ai le so'oga fa'amaonia, ma e te tatalaina le so'oga fa'amaonia i le tagata fa'atau lava e tasi o lo'o e saini mai ai.
ssoError.retryHint: Toe taumafai e saini i totonu i le Pangea Chat ma afai e fa'aauau pea le fa'afitauli fa'amolemole fa'afeso'ota'i le pule o le server.
authSuccess.title: Manuia!
authSuccess.mayClose: E mafai nei ona e tapunia lenei fa'amalama ma toe fo'i i le talosaga
registrationSuccess.title: Fa'amaoniga Manuia
registrationSuccess.body: Fa'amalo! Ua fa'amaonia lau imeli. Fa'amolemole toe fo'i i le app e saini ai!
passwordResetConfirm.title: Fa'amaoniga toe setiina o le upu fa'alilolilo
passwordResetConfirm.intro: Ua e talosagaina e toe setiina lau upu fa'alilolilo o le Pangea Chat. Kiliki le so'oga i lalo e fa'amaonia ai lenei gaioiga.
passwordResetConfirm.disclaimer: Afai e te le'i mana'o e fai lea, fa'amolemole tapuni lenei itulau ma o le a le suia lau upu fa'alilolilo.
passwordResetConfirm.submit: Fa'amaonia le suia o la'u upu fa'alilolilo
